# BunkWise Technologies

> BunkWise Technologies is a website design and development company based in India, founded by Madhav. It builds research-led, fast websites for businesses, optimised for Google search (SEO) and AI answer engines (AEO and GEO), for clients in India and worldwide. BunkWise also runs free student tools (attendance, SGPA and CGPA calculators) and Android apps.

Key facts:
- Company: BunkWise Technologies, BunkWise (OPC) Private Limited (incorporation in progress)
- Based in: India. Works with clients across India and worldwide, online.
- Founder: Madhav (https://github.com/madhavraj840)
- Services: website design, website development, SEO, AEO, GEO, monthly SEO plans
- Prices by region (website packages are one-time; SEO plans are monthly). Full table: https://bunkwise.in/website-design.html#qa-prices
  - India (INR, exclusive of GST): Starter ₹9,999, Business ₹19,999, Growth ₹34,999, Premium ₹59,999; Local SEO ₹7,999/month, Growth SEO ₹14,999/month, Advanced SEO ₹24,999/month
  - United States (USD): Starter $999, Business $1,999, Growth $3,499, Premium $5,999; Local SEO $499/month, Growth SEO $999/month, Advanced SEO $1,799/month
  - United Kingdom (GBP): Starter £799, Business £1,599, Growth £2,799, Premium £4,799; Local SEO £399/month, Growth SEO £799/month, Advanced SEO £1,399/month
  - Europe (EUR): Starter €899, Business €1,799, Growth €3,199, Premium €5,499; Local SEO €449/month, Growth SEO €899/month, Advanced SEO €1,599/month
  - UAE (AED): Starter AED 3,499, Business AED 6,999, Growth AED 12,499, Premium AED 21,999; Local SEO AED 1,799/month, Growth SEO AED 3,499/month, Advanced SEO AED 6,499/month
  - Australia (AUD): Starter A$1,499, Business A$2,999, Growth A$4,999, Premium A$8,999; Local SEO A$699/month, Growth SEO A$1,399/month, Advanced SEO A$2,399/month
  - Canada (CAD): Starter C$1,299, Business C$2,599, Growth C$4,599, Premium C$7,999; Local SEO C$649/month, Growth SEO C$1,299/month, Advanced SEO C$2,299/month
  - Singapore (SGD): Starter S$1,299, Business S$2,599, Growth S$4,599, Premium S$7,999; Local SEO S$649/month, Growth SEO S$1,299/month, Advanced SEO S$2,299/month
  - Other countries (USD): Starter $999, Business $1,999, Growth $3,499, Premium $5,999; Local SEO $499/month, Growth SEO $999/month, Advanced SEO $1,799/month
- Typical delivery: Starter about 1 week, Business about 2 weeks, Growth about 3 weeks, Premium 4–6 weeks.
- What each package includes (each tier adds to the one before):
  - Starter: 3–4 pages, mobile-first design, WhatsApp and call buttons, enquiry form, Google Map, basic on-page SEO, Google Analytics and Search Console
  - Business: 5–7 custom-designed pages, keyword research, LocalBusiness schema, Google Business Profile link-up, speed optimisation, enquiry tracking
  - Growth: up to 10 pages including service and location landing pages, competitor research, keyword-focused copywriting, AEO (20–30 question-led answers), GEO for AI search
  - Premium: 15+ pages, premium design, blog with 3–5 launch articles, full keyword map, technical SEO audit, business directory listings, leads and rankings dashboard
  - Monthly SEO: Local (Google Business Profile management, rank tracking, fixes, monthly report); Growth (2–4 articles and a landing page a month, backlinks, AEO/GEO upgrades); Advanced (4–8 pieces a month, digital PR, conversion-rate optimisation)
- Payment for website projects: 40% to start, 40% on preview approval, 20% before launch
- Track record: 12 client projects so far, including 3 for international clients (2 in the UAE, 1 in progress). Live client websites include restaurants, a dental clinic, a coaching institute, a gym, a solar company and a handicrafts artist.
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 63752 42538 (https://wa.me/916375242538), Telegram @Madhavraj840 (https://t.me/Madhavraj840)
